```powershell
Write-Output '=== DT MERGE SECOND REROUTE 380 - THE STRUCT WAS THE MISSING HALF (Job 376 restored DT_Dialogue.uasset.krk at 2363 bytes out of D:\VEIL-OMNI-ARCHIVE and unpacked it to 5814 bytes at its original path under D:\OMNI-UE, and the OMNI project load still returned None and the job stopped before any write. The reading that fits the record: a DataTable whose row struct asset stands absent cannot load, and the struct PHIDialogueRow is its own asset - if job 358 packed the Data folder whole, the struct stands packed in the same archive beside the table. THIS JOB, merged base at D:\VEIL-OMNI only for the merge: one, census the archive KRAKEN_MANIFEST.json for every entry whose name carries Dialogue or PHIDialogue and print each with its archive path, original path and bytes, with a filename census of the archive beside it. Two, restore each found asset into the merged base at its original relative Content path through the kraken tooling, copied never moved, any file already standing at a target backed up first as .phi-backup-380, restored bytes printed per file - the OMNI table itself is unpacked to a staging file in Saved, never dropped onto the base table path. Three, in the merged base project only: print the base table struct name and row census as it stands, then swap the staged OMNI table onto the base table path with the base file backed up, load it and export through export_to_json_string, print its struct name and row census, and restore the base table file from its backup on every road; if the OMNI table still loads None inside the merged base, print that verdict and stop. Four, merge with VEIL rows kept and OMNI rows appended only where the row name stands absent, skips printed, fill the base table through fill_from_json_string, save, re-export and print the full merged census with the total - 37 rows is the shape of done.) ==='
$waited = 0
while ((Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -and $waited -lt 8) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 15; $waited++ }
if (Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Output 'EDITOR STILL OPEN after 2 min - job deferred.'; Write-Output 'JOB 380 DEFERRED'; return }
$cmdexe = 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe'
$base = 'D:\VEIL-OMNI'
$arch = 'D:\VEIL-OMNI-ARCHIVE'
$baseDT = "$base\Content\Data\DT_Dialogue.uasset"
$stageDT = "$base\Saved\phi_dt380_omni_table.uasset"
$uprojV = "$base\VEIL.uproject"
Write-Output '--- SECTION 1: ARCHIVE MANIFEST CENSUS FOR DIALOGUE ---'
if (-not (Test-Path $arch)) { Write-Output 'ARCHIVE ROOT ABSENT'; Write-Output 'JOB 380 STOPPED'; return }
$man = "$arch\KRAKEN_MANIFEST.json"
if (Test-Path $man) {
  Write-Output "PHI DT380 MANIFEST STANDS: $man"
  Select-String -Path $man -Pattern 'Dialogue' | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() } | Write-Output
} else { Write-Output 'PHI DT380 KRAKEN MANIFEST ABSENT AT ARCHIVE ROOT' }
$hits = Get-ChildItem $arch -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -like '*Dialogue*' }
foreach ($h in $hits) { Write-Output ("PHI DT380 ARCHIVE FILENAME HIT: " + $h.FullName + ' bytes=' + $h.Length) }
if (-not $hits) { Write-Output 'PHI DT380 NO DIALOGUE FILENAME STANDS IN THE ARCHIVE' }
Write-Output '--- SECTION 2: KRAKEN TOOLING ---'
$tools = 'C:\Users\Admin\phi-vault\phi-dlam\tools\kraken_ton618.py'
if (-not (Test-Path $tools)) { $tools = (Get-ChildItem 'C:\Users\Admin' -Recurse -Depth 5 -Filter 'kraken_ton618.py' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName) }
if (-not $tools) { Write-Output 'KRAKEN TOOLING FILE NOT FOUND ON THIS PC'; Write-Output 'JOB 380 STOPPED'; return }
Write-Output "KRAKEN TOOL: $tools"
$py = (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source
if (-not $py) { $py = (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source }
if (-not $py) { Write-Output 'PYTHON NOT FOUND'; Write-Output 'JOB 380 STOPPED'; return }
Write-Output "PYTHON: $py"
& $py -c "import numpy, zstandard; print('PHI KRAKEN DEPS OK')" 2>&1 | Write-Output
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
  Write-Output 'DEPS MISSING - one install attempt'
  & $py -m pip install numpy zstandard 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 3 | Write-Output
  & $py -c "import numpy, zstandard; print('PHI KRAKEN DEPS OK AFTER INSTALL')" 2>&1 | Write-Output
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Output 'TOOLING NOT READY - nothing restored.'; Write-Output 'JOB 380 STOPPED'; return }
}
$toolsDirFwd = (Split-Path $tools) -replace '\\', '/'
Write-Output '--- SECTION 3: BASE TABLE READ IN THE MERGED BASE ---'
$pyB0 = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
$pyB0 = $pyB0.Replace('OUTFILE', "'$base\Saved\phi_dt380_base_out.txt'").Replace('JSONOUT', "'$base\Saved\phi_dt380_base_rows.json'")
Set-Content "$base\Saved\phi_dt380_base.py" -Value $pyB0 -Encoding UTF8
Remove-Item "$base\Saved\phi_dt380_base_out.txt" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
& $cmdexe $uprojV -run=pythonscript -script="$base\Saved\phi_dt380_base.py" -unattended -nopause -nosplash *> "$base\Saved\dt380_base.log"
if (Test-Path "$base\Saved\phi_dt380_base_out.txt") { $b0out = Get-Content "$base\Saved\phi_dt380_base_out.txt"; $b0out | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NO DT380 BASE OUTPUT FILE'; Write-Output 'JOB 380 STOPPED'; return }
if (($b0out -join "`n") -match 'BASE LOAD NONE') { Write-Output 'PHI DT380 BASE TABLE ITSELF UNREADABLE - stop before restore'; Write-Output 'JOB 380 STOPPED'; return }
Write-Output '--- SECTION 4: RESTORE DIALOGUE ASSETS INTO THE MERGED BASE ---'
$pyA = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
$pyA = $pyA.Replace('ZZTOOLSZZ', "'" + $toolsDirFwd + "'").Replace('ZZMANIFESTZZ', "'D:/VEIL-OMNI-ARCHIVE/KRAKEN_MANIFEST.json'").Replace('ZZARCHZZ', "'D:/VEIL-OMNI-ARCHIVE'").Replace('ZZBASEZZ', "'D:/VEIL-OMNI'").Replace('ZZSTAGEZZ', "'D:/VEIL-OMNI/Saved/phi_dt380_omni_table.uasset'").Replace('ZZOUTZZ', "'D:/VEIL-OMNI/Saved/phi_dt380_restore_out.txt'")
Set-Content "$base\Saved\phi_dt380_restore.py" -Value $pyA -Encoding UTF8
Remove-Item "$base\Saved\phi_dt380_restore_out.txt" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item $stageDT -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item "$stageDT.krk" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
& $py "$base\Saved\phi_dt380_restore.py" 2>&1 | Write-Output
if (Test-Path "$base\Saved\phi_dt380_restore_out.txt") { Get-Content "$base\Saved\phi_dt380_restore_out.txt" | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NO DT380 RESTORE OUTPUT FILE'; Write-Output 'JOB 380 STOPPED'; return }
Write-Output '--- SECTION 5: OMNI TABLE READ INSIDE THE MERGED BASE ---'
$swapped = $false
if (Test-Path $stageDT) {
  Copy-Item $baseDT "$baseDT.phi-backup-380" -Force
  Copy-Item $stageDT $baseDT -Force
  $swapped = $true
  Write-Output 'PHI DT380 OMNI TABLE SWAPPED ONTO THE BASE TABLE PATH (base file backed up .phi-backup-380)'
} else { Write-Output 'PHI DT380 NO STAGED OMNI TABLE - section 5 skipped'; Write-Output 'JOB 380 STOPPED'; return }
$pyB1 = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
$pyB1 = $pyB1.Replace('OUTFILE', "'$base\Saved\phi_dt380_omni_out.txt'").Replace('JSONOUT', "'$base\Saved\phi_dt380_omni_rows.json'")
Set-Content "$base\Saved\phi_dt380_omni.py" -Value $pyB1 -Encoding UTF8
Remove-Item "$base\Saved\phi_dt380_omni_out.txt" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item "$base\Saved\phi_dt380_omni_rows.json" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
& $cmdexe $uprojV -run=pythonscript -script="$base\Saved\phi_dt380_omni.py" -unattended -nopause -nosplash *> "$base\Saved\dt380_omni.log"
$b1out = $null
if (Test-Path "$base\Saved\phi_dt380_omni_out.txt") { $b1out = Get-Content "$base\Saved\phi_dt380_omni_out.txt"; $b1out | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NO DT380 OMNI OUTPUT FILE' }
if ($swapped) { Copy-Item "$baseDT.phi-backup-380" $baseDT -Force; Write-Output 'PHI DT380 BASE TABLE FILE RESTORED FROM BACKUP' }
if (-not $b1out) { Write-Output 'JOB 380 STOPPED'; return }
if (($b1out -join "`n") -match 'OMNI LOAD NONE INSIDE MERGED BASE') { Write-Output 'PHI DT380 VERDICT: OMNI TABLE STILL UNREADABLE INSIDE THE MERGED BASE'; Write-Output 'JOB 380 STOPPED'; return }
if (($b1out -join "`n") -notmatch 'OMNI STRUCT: PHIDialogueRow') { Write-Output 'PHI DT380 OMNI STRUCT GATE FAILED - stop before merge'; Write-Output 'JOB 380 STOPPED'; return }
if (-not (Test-Path "$base\Saved\phi_dt380_omni_rows.json")) { Write-Output 'DT380 OMNI ROWS JSON MISSING - merge not run.'; Write-Output 'JOB 380 STOPPED'; return }
Write-Output '--- SECTION 6: MERGE IN THE MERGED BASE ---'
$pyB2 = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
$pyB2 = $pyB2.Replace('OUTFILE', "'$base\Saved\phi_dt380_merge_out.txt'").Replace('OMNIJSON', "'$base\Saved\phi_dt380_omni_rows.json'")
Set-Content "$base\Saved\phi_dt380_merge.py" -Value $pyB2 -Encoding UTF8
Remove-Item "$base\Saved\phi_dt380_merge_out.txt" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
& $cmdexe $uprojV -run=pythonscript -script="$base\Saved\phi_dt380_merge.py" -unattended -nopause -nosplash *> "$base\Saved\dt380_merge.log"
if (Test-Path "$base\Saved\phi_dt380_merge_out.txt") { Get-Content "$base\Saved\phi_dt380_merge_out.txt" | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NO DT380 MERGE OUTPUT FILE'; Write-Output 'JOB 380 STOPPED'; return }
$bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($baseDT)
$text = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($bytes)
$ids = [regex]::Matches($text, '[VO][0-9][0-9]') | ForEach-Object { $_.Value } | Sort-Object -Unique
Write-Output ("PHI DT380 FINAL CENSUS rows=" + $ids.Count + " : " + ($ids -join ' '))
Write-Output 'JOB 380 DONE'
```
